statement: ∀ (C : Set (Space n)) (a b : ℝ), IsClosed C → (∀ x r, x ∉ C → r ∈ Set.Ioo a b → (ubar u q) (x,r) = q) → ∀ x r, x ∉ C → r ∈ Set.Ioo a b → velocity (ubar u q) x r = 0 ∧ ∀ j, spatial (ubar u q) j x r = 0
proof:
intro C a b hC hv x r hx hr
constructor
· funext k
  have he : (fun s => (ubar u q) (x,s) k) =ᶠ[𝓝 r] (fun _ => q k) := by
    filter_upwards [isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds hr] with s hs
    exact congrFun (hv x s hx hs) k
  change deriv (fun s => (ubar u q) (x,s) k) r = 0
  rw [he.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
· intro j
  funext k
  have he : (fun y => (ubar u q) (y,r) k) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun _ => q k) := by
    filter_upwards [hC.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hx] with y hy
    exact congrFun (hv y r hy hr) k
  change fderiv ℝ (fun y => (ubar u q) (y,r) k) x (Pi.single j 1) = 0
  rw [@yui_aux_0001 n m u q h_H006 h_T003 _ x (q k) he]
  rfl

checked : ∀ (n m : ℕ) (u : Space n × ↑(Set.Ioi 0) → Value m) (q : Value m),
  CompactPerturbation (ubar u q) q →
    (FirstCalculus (ubar u q) ∧
        SecondCalculus (ubar u q) ∧
          ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p => density (ubar u q) p.1 p.2) {p | 0 < p.2} ∧
            ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p => densityRate (ubar u q) p.1 p.2) {p | 0 < p.2} ∧
              (∀ (x : Space n) (t : ℝ),
                  0 < t → HasDerivAt (fun r => density (ubar u q) x r) (densityRate (ubar u q) x t) t) ∧
                (∀ (j : Fin n) (x : Space n) (t : ℝ),
                    0 < t →
                      ∀ (k : Fin m),
                        (fderiv ℝ (fun y => ubar u q (y, t) k) x) (Pi.single j 1) = spatial (ubar u q) j x t k ∧
                          (fderiv ℝ (fun y => velocity (ubar u q) y t k) x) (Pi.single j 1) = mixed (ubar u q) j x t k ∧
                            (fderiv ℝ (fun y => spatial (ubar u q) j y t k) x) (Pi.single j 1) =
                              spatialSecond (ubar u q) j x t k) ∧
                  (∀ (x : Space n) (t : ↑(Set.Ioi 0)), ubar u q (x, ↑t) = u (x, t)) ∧
                    ∀ (x : Space n), ∀ t ≤ 0, ubar u q (x, t) = q) →
      ∀ (C : Set (Space n)) (a b : ℝ),
        IsClosed C →
          (∀ (x : Space n) (r : ℝ), x ∉ C → r ∈ Set.Ioo a b → ubar u q (x, r) = q) →
            ∀ (x : Space n) (r : ℝ),
              x ∉ C → r ∈ Set.Ioo a b → velocity (ubar u q) x r = 0 ∧ ∀ (j : Fin n), spatial (ubar u q) j x r = 0
